name: @wc-toolkit/cem-generator-utils
reason: Preserve callable, constructor and index signatures and their precedence in expanded types. Preserve consuming source scope in inferred and expanded type references. Preserve repeated and conditional constituent precedence; parse complete type syntax before splitting top-level operators. Delegate structural syntax to the owning compiler, preserving readonly, tuple element flags, method variance and instantiated aliases. Preserve authored type text when compaction changes its parsed structure/literal tokens; collapse boolean unions only when both literal values or boolean are present. Add reviewed own-constructor extraction and provenance bindings for the separately qualified composition tier; preserve the ordinary production route. Bind event dispatch to original compiler-owned receiver and constructor identity. Retain direct JSDoc ownership and source scope in shared parsing.
